resources.string: Voice typing uses your phone\'s speech service, normally Google\'s. While you speak, your voice is sent to Google to be turned into text. Nothing you type is ever sent. The next step asks for the microphone permission.
Microphone allowed. Hold the mic key and speak.
Voice typing needs the microphone permission.
Hold the mic key and speak
Voice typing needs an internet connection
No speech service found on this phone. Install or enable Google\'s speech services.
This language is not available for voice typing on this phone
Voice typing is busy, try again in a moment
Voice typing needs the microphone permission
Voice typing did not work, try again
The voice model is not installed. Open Settings > Voice typing to download it.
Offline mode is on. Turn it off in Settings > Voice typing to use Google voice or to download a model.
Microphone key: engine per language, offline models, Offline mode

Hold the microphone key in the keyboard\'s top row and speak. The language follows the layout you are typing in. Google is the speech service of your phone; a downloaded model works offline and sends nothing anywhere.
Download paused at %1$s of %2$s. It continues where it stopped.
Downloading… %1$d%% of %2$s. Keep this screen open.
If you already downloaded the .gguf file with a browser
That file is not the expected model (its size or SHA-256 differs).
The model is about %1$s and comes from %2$s. It is checked against a pinned SHA-256 before it is used. Wi-Fi is recommended.
The first dictation after a while takes a moment longer because the model has to be loaded. It is freed again after a minute of not using it.
Never use the internet: blocks the model download and Google voice. Downloaded models keep working.
Models: %1$s. Speech recognition runs with transcribe.cpp (MIT).
Understand the spoken words for the marks (দাঁড়ি, কমা, প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন, বিস্ময়সূচক চিহ্ন) and end a sentence without a mark with a danda ।
Installed (1 MB). Keeps music, noise and silence out of the transcript.
Not installed yet (1 MB). It downloads by itself next to a model; without it noise can be written as words such as music.
Find out why Google voice does not work on this phone and copy the report
Google\'s speech service refused (insufficient permissions). In the phone\'s Settings > Apps open Speech Recognition & Synthesis from Google and allow the microphone.

Speech Recognition & Synthesis from Google has no microphone permission on this phone, so Google voice fails with "insufficient permissions". Open its settings, then Permissions, and allow the microphone.
